research_contract.target: Verify one pre-Origin budget-ten Selector whose direct target-Agent future pass-rate MAE is lower than Full eligible repository-local history at both H5 and H10 on the fixed-Harness modern development panel.
research_contract.terminal_success: The unchanged frozen candidate is strictly better than Full at both H5 and H10, passes target-column and time audits, reproduces byte-identically, and reports repository, Agent, Origin, and random directions.
research_contract.claim_boundary: Passing establishes an outcome-open modern development candidate only. It does not establish prospective validity, production readiness, or independent unseen-population confirmation.

search_provenance.expert_family: nine historical pooled-rate forecasts by four disagreement weights by two deterministic within-count tie modes
search_provenance.selected_expert: full pooled-rate forecast, lexicographic minimum disagreement, recent-first within equal response-count groups
search_provenance.selected_because: It was the strongest unchanged fixed expert at H5 and also improved H10; it is simpler and had lower direct MAE than the prequential meta policy at both horizons.

candidate.runtime_unit: one target Agent, one repository, one Task Pool, and one Selection
candidate.reference_panel: All admitted reference Agents other than the target Agent. The target Agent may be absent from the reference panel; the leave-one-target-out development replay simulates that deployment boundary.
candidate.forecast: The pooled binary pass rate over every eligible historical Task and every reference Agent.
candidate.task_statistic: For each historical Task, the integer count c of passing reference Agents out of m reference Agents.
candidate.primary_objective: Among ten-distinct-Task subsets, minimize the absolute difference between the subset pooled reference pass rate sum(c)/(10*m) and the full-history pooled reference pass rate.
candidate.secondary_objective: Lexicographically minimize sum(c*(m-c)) among primary-objective ties. This prefers reference-panel consensus without trading away the pooled-rate match.
tertiary_ties: prefer the most recent Tasks within an equal response-count group
candidate.solver: Exact dynamic programming over response-count compositions followed by deterministic membership materialization.
candidate.horizon_parameter: The same Selector is used unchanged at H5 and H10; horizon only determines rolling Origin boundaries and does not alter the objective.

membership_may_read: current repository-local eligible Task identities and created_at order
historical binary outcomes of admitted reference Agents
membership_must_not_read: the target Agent outcome column at any time
the six project-sealed Agent outcome blobs
information_contract.required_perturbation: Flipping the target Agent complete outcome column must leave every membership unchanged.

frame.aggregation: Average target Agents and Origins inside each repository, then weight repositories equally.
frame.primary_metric: Direct absolute error between selected target-Agent pass rate and next-block target-Agent pass rate.

sensitivity: repositories with more than one Origin
ablations: pooled-rate match without the consensus secondary objective

confirmation.secondary_opened_diagnostic: After implementation and primary evidence are bound, replay unchanged on the already-open three-Agent SWE-bench Full lane. This is a transfer diagnostic, not independent confirmation.
confirmation.six_project_sealed_agents: Remain unread in this study. Their legacy population no longer matches the modern fixed-Harness target population and they are not required by the parent development-success contract.
